QuestInfo.name: Honnou-ji Infiltration 2
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Yukimura about the infiltration plan.
QuestInfo.1: Princess Sakuno is here somewhere. Hurry to the Eastern Wing!
QuestInfo.2: Princess Sakuno is safe! It doesn't look like Nobunaga was too rough with her either.

0.0: The Mouri dogs were right. Security in this area is lax as can be.
0.1: The Eastern wing of the temple is right over this wall. Prove yourself worthy of your name, Bladed Falcon. The princess needs you.

yes.0: I shall remain here to protect the escape route. Be cautious. It is still possible that the frail security is a trap.

default.0: I don't see Princess Sakuno by your side.
